title: Cast speed
wikitext:
{{redirect|Cast Speed|the passive skill|Cast Speed (passive skill)}}

'''Cast speed''' is a [[keyword]] and refers to the speed of [[Use|using]] [[skill]]s which are [[spell]]s and is calculated as [[Use|uses]] per second. Casting a spell consists of [[cast time]] and other time mechanics and [[Effect|spell effect]]. '''Cast speed''' is calculated as 1 second/cast time of spell.

Cast speed can be found throughout the game, on [[passive skill]]s, [[equipment]], [[skill gem]]s, monster [[affix]]es, [[map]] affixes, and so on.

The base '''[[cast time]]''' is derived from the [[spell]] being used, it is the length of time required to cast a spell. '''Cast speed''' is a derived stat which is equal to 1 divided by '''Cast Time'''. Therefore if the cast speed is increased, the cast time is reduced. For example, if a player is using a skill with a base cast time of 0.8 seconds, and the player has a total of {{c|mod|50% increased Cast Speed}}, then the modified cast time can be calculated as follows:
{{Math|formula=
\begin{align}
1 / 0.8 &= 1.25 \text{ casts per second }&\text{base cast speed} \\
1.25 * ( 1 + 0.5 ) &= 1.88 \text{ casts per second }&\text{modified cast speed} \\
1 / 1.88 &= 0.53 \text{ seconds }&\text{modified cast time}
\end{align} }}

[[Frenzy charge]]s increase cast speed by 4% per charge.

==Base items==
Some base items increase or reduce cast speed by a percentage.

{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = 
    item_stats.id LIKE "%base_cast_speed_+%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=% increased Cast Speed
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=base_cast_speed_+%
}}

==Unique items==

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant cast speed bonuses. 

===Cast speed===
These passive skills grant increased cast speed.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "base_cast_speed_+%"
}}

===Cast speed and attack speed===
These passive skills grant increased cast speed and attack speed

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "attack_and_cast_speed_+%"
}}
